topic: planning compass-straightedge constructions and justifications (study guide)

problems.desc: Worked plan for the perpendicular bisector of a segment -- an ordered list of compass and straightedge moves, checked by reading the plan, not by computation.
Try-it plan for bisecting an angle, naming the two arcs that must share one compass opening -- checked by reading the plan, not by computation.
Worked justification that the two equal-radius arcs make triangle ABC equilateral, using the definition of a circle -- a proof, checked by reading the argument.
Try-it justification naming the congruent triangles and the SSS criterion in the perpendicular-bisector construction -- a proof, checked by reading the argument.
